summary: Post-startup-seeding-change auth regression smoke (frontend only). Verified both admin (sales@dbgsigns.com) and salesman (sam@dbgsigns.com) can log in, land on their correct pages, protected pages load without 401 errors, session persists across reload, and logout redirects protected routes back to /login. No regressions from the create-only admin seed change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is stable after startup() change to create-only admin seed. Detailed results: (1) Admin login POST /api/auth/login -> 200, redirected to /dashboard. (2) /customers loaded with ~370 rows, no 401. (3) /invoices loaded (empty list, expected). (4) Reload on /invoices preserved session. (5) 'Sign out' button worked, subsequent nav to /customers redirected to /login. (6) Salesman login redirected to /estimates with 'Welcome, Sam Salesman' toast, no 401. (7) Only 401s observed were the expected /api/auth/me probes on unauthenticated states (initial page load + immediately after logout) — these are normal AuthContext bootstrap checks and not regressions.
